name: Network Topology for Zabbix — WLAN Widget
author: PlaNet Fox | Alexander Fox
description: Dashboard widget: a WLAN overview of the access points in the selected host groups — client count, radios (channel/standard per band), CPU/memory and status, one row per AP. Reads the same data as the map; client count needs the APs monitored over SNMP (wlan.clients). Requires the main module (network_topology).
